recap: Goal: Teaching simulation: prioritize contacts when call capacity is limited; the prediction is made before the first contact of the campaign, from the client file.

Decided: prediction moment; feature availability (excluded campaign, day, duration, month; kept with a doubt contact); split (stratified random, 30% for validation); policy threshold:0.2 (the logistic model at threshold:0.2 on the 1357 validation rows: precision 34.8%, recall 25.6%, result ae80b53f).
Now: Conclude proportionately; the report and notebook are up to date.
Next: your answer, in your own words, on the policy: "Call the 100 clients with the highest scores."
